item.text: I’ll inspect the repository’s TypeScript and test conventions, then implement the smallest compatible export and run the relevant checks.

The repository is intentionally minimal. I’ll pass the pattern and directory as separate `rg` arguments (so spaces and leading dashes are safe), use per-file line counts, and sum them; ripgrep’s normal “no matches” exit will map to zero.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc 'command -v tsc || true
command -v rg
work_area=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir "$work_area/directory with spaces"
printf '"'hit here\\nmiss\\nhit twice hit\\n' > \""'$work_area/directory with spaces/file one.txt"
printf '"'hit again\\n' > \""'$work_area/directory with spaces/file two.txt"
rg --count --no-filename -- '"'hit' \""'$work_area/directory with spaces"
rg --count --no-filename -- '"'not present' \""'$work_area/directory with spaces"; test $? -eq 1'
